known_ok.note: Deleting by index while iterating backwards is correct: removing item i never shifts the indices still to be visited (all < i). Checked against 2,000 random stores.
<= is correct: models.Session.is_valid says a session is valid while now < expires_at, so at expires_at it has expired and is purged.
Swallowing KeyError is intentional and documented: revoking an unknown or already-revoked token is a no-op so logout is idempotent.

related_valid: The store has no locking; concurrent requests in one worker with threads could race. Pre-existing design (one store per worker), not introduced here.
_items.remove(session) in revoke is O(n) per logout.
